Similarly, features like mean compactness, mean concavity, and mean concave points—the ones that reflect irregularities in cell nuclei—are significantly elevated in malignant tumors. Worse values (worst radius, worst texture, etc.) also correlate strongly with malignancy, as they represent the most abnormal measurements across the lesion. Thus, the features that would most strongly shift the prediction toward malignancy are those with higher threshold values in malignant cases.
